VertexRT FreeRTOS Xtensa Vendor Set
====================================

Platform:
    ESP32
    Arduino-ESP32 framework
    ESP-IDF SDK bundled with PlatformIO

SDK root:
    C:\Users\DELL\.platformio\packages\framework-arduinoespressif32\tools\sdk\esp32

Copied components:

1. Xtensa generic headers
   Source:
       C:\Users\DELL\.platformio\packages\framework-arduinoespressif32\tools\sdk\esp32\include\xtensa\include\xtensa

   Destination:
       external/freertos_xtensa/include/xtensa/

2. FreeRTOS Xtensa port headers
   Source:
       C:\Users\DELL\.platformio\packages\framework-arduinoespressif32\tools\sdk\esp32\include\freertos\port\xtensa\include\freertos

   Destination:
       external/freertos_xtensa/include/freertos/

3. ESP32 FreeRTOSConfig.h
   Source:
       C:\Users\DELL\.platformio\packages\framework-arduinoespressif32\tools\sdk\esp32\include\freertos\include\esp_additions\freertos\FreeRTOSConfig.h

   Destination:
       external/freertos_xtensa/include/freertos/include/esp_additions/freertos/

4. FreeRTOS Xtensa portasm.S
   Source:
       

   Destination:
       external/freertos_xtensa/src/portasm.S

This directory intentionally does NOT contain the complete ESP-IDF SDK.
